narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten choices and ten choices make twenty passwords.
<bookmark mark='grid'/>Every first digit has its own ten second digits. That gives ten rows of ten.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ten rows of ten is far more than twenty, so the bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 10 + 10 = 20 passwords; the grid fills with ten rows of ten; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Multiply the choices for every slot, one slot at a time.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A lock has four wheels, and each shows only one, two or three. How many passwords?
removed_beats.on_screen: the line multiply the choices for every slot appears; a new lock with 4 wheels that show only 1, 2 and 3 appears with an empty box
